svg.text: Ten distinct visual directions for a compact memory indicator.
Each is shown again at 44 px panel scale.

g.text: One calm sweep with the value at its center.
Discrete radial ticks, like an instrument dial.
Memory reads as a rising fluid level.
Five bands fill in clear 20% steps.
A chip whose internal banks light up.
A satellite advances around memory space.
A trace pairs the current load with motion.
A large, immediate number and fine rule.
Hex cells offer a softer, compact pattern.
A ticked ruler inside a targeting frame.

svg.text: ALL CONCEPTS SHOWN AT 44 PX PANEL SCALE
